```yaml
name: Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Target version (e.g., 1.4.0)'
        required: true
        default: '1.4.0'

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0  # required for tags

      - name: Set up Python 3.9
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install pylint bump2version

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          pytest

      - name: Run pylint
        run: |
          pylint $(git ls-files '*.py')

      - name: Check current version
        id: check
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
        run: |
          CURRENT_VERSION=$(jq -r .version custom_components/dreo/manifest.json)
          echo "current=$CURRENT_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          if [ "$CURRENT_VERSION" != "$VERSION" ]; then
            echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "changed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Configure git for bump
        if: steps.check.outputs.changed == 'true'
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Bump version
        if: steps.check.outputs.changed == 'true'
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
        run: |
          bump2version --new-version $VERSION --config .bumpversion.cfg
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Push changes and tags
        if: steps.check.outputs.changed == 'true'
        run: |
          git push origin HEAD
          git push origin --tags

      - name: Zip custom component
        if: steps.check.outputs.changed == 'true'
        uses: thedoctor0/zip-release@0.7.6
        with:
          filename: dreo-${{ inputs.version }}.zip
          path: custom_components/dreo

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        if: steps.check.outputs.changed == 'true'
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        with:
          tag_name: v${{ inputs.version }}
          name: Release v${{ inputs.version }}
          body: |
            Release notes for v${{ inputs.version }}.
          files: dreo-${{ inputs.version }}.zip
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
